headline: YouTube Growth & Content Manager | Financial Markets & Forex Specialist
summary: Results-driven YouTube Growth & Content Manager with 4+ years of experience in digital marketing and video content strategy, specializing in financial markets, Forex, and Crypto. Proven track record of owning end-to-end channel strategy, scripting, and production for high-engagement financial content. Expert in leveraging YouTube Studio analytics, retention analysis, and SEO optimization to drive subscriber growth and qualified trader acquisition. Fluent in Arabic and English, with deep knowledge of regulatory compliance, risk warnings, and cross-cultural audience engagement in MENA and global markets.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Owned end-to-end YouTube and social media channel strategy for a major Forex and Crypto financial platform, driving significant growth in subscribers, watch time, and qualified lead generation.

Developed and executed comprehensive content calendars featuring long-form market outlooks, weekly technical analysis, trading education, and platform tutorials, ensuring consistent publishing schedules.

Authored high-converting scripts and hooks for video content, accurately explaining complex financial concepts (CFDs, leverage, spreads) to new traders while maintaining strict regulatory compliance and risk warnings.
Managed video production end-to-end, briefing editors, motion designers, and presenters to maintain high quality standards for shoots, editing, thumbnails, and captions.

Optimized channel discovery through structured A/B testing of titles and thumbnails, leveraging YouTube Studio data (CTR, average view duration, retention curves) to refine content strategy and boost organic reach.
Grew Arabic-speaking audiences in Egypt and the wider MENA region by localizing content and adapting messaging to cultural nuances, resulting in increased engagement and trust.

Integrated YouTube content with acquisition funnels using tracked links, UTMs, and pinned comments to drive registrations and funded accounts, collaborating with performance marketing teams on retargeting audiences.
Built and managed community engagement through comments, live chat, and premieres, handling negative sentiment with sound judgment and ensuring adherence to platform policies on financial content.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Supported user growth and engagement strategies across MENA, EU, and Asian markets, focusing on content-driven acquisition and retention.
Executed AMA campaigns and KOL relations, collaborating with finance creators and presenters to produce engaging video and live stream content.
Analyzed channel performance metrics to identify growth opportunities, applying data-driven insights to improve content resonance and audience retention.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the YouTube Growth & Content Manager role at DB Investing. With over four years of experience owning financial market channels, I have a proven track record of driving subscriber growth, optimizing retention, and converting viewers into traders. My expertise in Forex content, regulatory compliance, and YouTube analytics aligns perfectly with your goals. I am eager to bring my hands-on production experience and data-driven strategy to your team, helping DB Investing dominate the MENA market. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your channel's success.

screening.q: Do you have at least 2 years of experience owning the strategy and growth of a YouTube channel in financial markets?
screening.a: Yes, I have over 4 years of experience in financial marketing, including specific ownership of channel strategy and growth for Forex and Crypto platforms.

screening.q: Are you fluent in both Arabic and English?
screening.a: Yes, I am native in Arabic and have professional working proficiency in English.
Yes, I am based in Egypt.

screening.q: Do you have experience with video production tools like Premiere Pro or CapCut?
screening.a: Yes, I have hands-on experience managing video production and using tools like Premiere Pro and CapCut for editing and content creation.
